description: Forgejo-platform overrides. Three things the platform gets wrong on its own. (1) Forgejo Actions don't populate the commit-status API that Renovate's prCreation:not-pending reads (GET /commits/{sha}/status is empty even on green CI), so not-pending never resolves and PRs hang the full prNotPendingHours. Force immediate PR creation on the Forgejo path. force: because consumers extend :default (not-pending) at the repo level, which only an admin-level force overrides. (2) The github-actions manager assigns datasource github-tags unconditionally, so a `uses:` pointing at a Forgejo-native repo is resolved against api.github.com. Where a github.com twin exists but carries no tags, that returns an empty list rather than an error — the pin freezes silently. The customManagers below read webgrip/* pins from Forgejo instead, in both shapes consumers write: digest plus version comment, and bare version tag. (3) The renovate-config manager skips local> presets, which is how a Forgejo-hosted preset is referenced, so the last customManager tracks those preset pins against Forgejo tags.

customManagers.description: webgrip/* job-level reusable workflows resolve against Forgejo, not github.com. gitea-tags implements getDigest, so a tag resolves to its commit and both halves of the pin — the digest and the `# vX.Y.Z` comment — move together. Discovered in twente.dev 2026-09-18, where seven pins had been unresolvable for months and three lanes sat on v1.6.0/v2.1.0 while v2.7.2 shipped; see that repo's ADR 0022.

webgrip/* pins written as a bare version tag, with no digest: the step-level composite-action form `uses: https://forgejo.webgrip.dev/webgrip/workflows/.forgejo/composite-actions/<name>@vX.Y.Z` and the job-level `uses: webgrip/workflows/.forgejo/workflows/<file>.yml@vX.Y.Z`. The github-actions manager does extract the absolute-URL form natively, but with packageName webgrip/workflows, so the webgrip/** disable rule below switches it off and the pin freezes; omnigraph-explorer and renovate-config sat on v2.0.0 and de-vloer on v1.2.0 while v2.7.5 shipped. The version must sit directly after the @ and end the token, so a digest pin (`@<40 hex> # vX.Y.Z`) never matches here and stays with the digest manager above.

Org preset references written as local>webgrip/renovate-config[:name]#vX.Y.Z in the repository config. The renovate-config manager resolves github>, gitlab> and gitea> presets but skips local>, so every pin froze where it was set: Glide sat on v1.9.0 and homelab-cluster on v1.6.0 while v1.10.0 shipped. forgejo-tags rather than gitea-tags keeps the bump out of the CI-only commit rule for workflow pins below.

packageRules.description: The github-actions manager still parses these files. Without this it proposes the same webgrip/* deps against github.com alongside the customManager and re-raises the lookup failures. custom.regex owns webgrip/* on the Forgejo path.
Keep those pins on the github-actions shape the default preset gives them: a CI-only commit that releases nothing. Matching by manager no longer reaches them, so restate it by datasource.

A custom manager captures a version but no digest, so the global pinDigests tries to append one, the replacement never applies, and one failed dep aborts the whole branch with 'Error updating branch: update failure' — the same way it does for the preset reference and for mise aqua entries (default.json rules 9 and 12).
